name: Brandenburg Gate
desc: The gate that watched empires, walls, and raves come and go. Costs nothing, means everything, open 24/7 like the city.

name: East Side Gallery
desc: 1.3 km of the actual Berlin Wall, painted by artists from everywhere. The world's longest open-air gallery; admission is a stroll.

name: Reichstag Dome
desc: A glass spiral above parliament with a free 360° of the whole city. Book ahead online — democracy's best free viewpoint.

name: Museum Island
desc: Five museums crowded onto one river island — Nefertiti lives here. Pick one, pay pocket money, feel cultured for a week.

name: Tempelhofer Feld
desc: An entire retired airport turned public park. Bike the runways, grill the infield, fly kites past the terminal. Peak Berlin, perfectly free.

name: Mauerpark Flea Market
desc: Sunday flea market plus open-air karaoke in a stone amphitheater. Strangers will cheer your worst singing. Free therapy.

name: Fernsehturm (TV Tower)
desc: The disco-ball-on-a-stick from every Berlin postcard. Someday: sunset from 203 meters. Until then it's your free compass home.

name: Tiergarten
desc: Berlin's green lung between the Gate and the zoo. Beer gardens hide among the trees; so do nude sunbathers. You've been warned.

name: Berlin Wall Memorial
desc: The stretch of Bernauer Strasse where the Wall's whole story is told, free and unflinching. Heavy, necessary, unforgettable.

name: Checkpoint Charlie
desc: The Cold War's most famous border booth, now surrounded by döner shops. Kitschy? Yes. Still gives chills? Also yes.
